During this period, he devoted himself to writing and annotated many classics, which collected the great achievements of Confucian classics in the Han Dynasty and was known as "The Study of Zheng". During the war of Guandu, Yuan Shao forced Zheng Xuan to be an official and accompany the army to suppress Cao Cao. Zheng died of illness in the way.

He was a native of Kaifeng, Henan province, with a young talent who had foreseen the chaos in the world and had warned He Jin not to attract Dong Zhuo as foreign aid. 
During Dong Zhuo's dictatorship, Zheng Tai tried to persuade Dong Zhuo to confer a large title on the lords and release Yuan Shao and other anti-Dong opponents, in order to secretly foster anti-Dong forces. 
Later, he conspired with Xun You and others to assassinate Dong Zhuo, and after the defeat, he defected to Yuan Shu.

Born and raised in Gaomi, Beihai. Son of Zheng Xuan, the great scholar of late Han Dynasty. When Kong Rong was under siege by Yellow Turban led by Guan Hai, Zheng Yi came to rescue with his forces and unfortunately died in battle.
A native of Donghai, Xuzhou, he was the minister of Luangxie and wanted to follow Lu Bu, but he was defeated by Taishan thieves leading his troops.

Female alchemist and immortal of Jin Dynasty. Legend has it that she was the disciple of Lan Gong. Xu Xun, one of her students, was regarded as the founder of Jingming Taosim and Lushan Sect. Some say Shen Mu is possibly Wei Huacun, the founding taoist of Maoshan Taoism.

Born and raised in Lingling, Jingzhou. At first, he was the subordinate of Liu Biao and later served under Liu Bei. He joined Zhuge Liang in a plea to the emperor to appoint Liu Bei King of Hanzhong. After Cao Pi usurped the throne, he persuaded Liu Bei to proclaim himself emperor. Later he also advised against Liu Bei's expeditions to Wu, but Liu Bei refused and ordered him to stay in Xichuan.

He was a native of Nantong, Rui, a young man who was an avid learner, knowledgeable, and skilled in the laws and regulations, as well as a commentator on the Book of Han, which became the "Book of Han, Collecting and Interpreting the Meanings". 
When he was the governor of Taishan, he defeated more than 300, 000 Yellow Turban soldiers. Later, when Cao Cao's father, Cao Song, was robbed and killed by Tao Qian while returning to his hometown through Taishan County, he abandoned his post and joined Yuan Shao for fear of Cao Cao's crime.

Born and raised in Nandun, Ru'nan. He was one of the Seven Scholars of Jian'an. "Soothing yet not powerful" was the comment on his poems by Cao Pi. Like Chen Lin, Xu Gan, Liu Zhen and others, he also died of plague.

Born and raised in Xiang County, Pei Commandery. After Xue Lan, who defected to Lu Bu, was killed by Cao troops. Xue Yong chose to serve under Liu Bei. Later he was appointed as the Governor of Shu Commandery.

Born and raised in Xiang County, Pei Commandery. Xue Qi succeeded his father as the Governor of Shu Commandery. After the demise of Shu, he surrendered to Wei and was appointed as Imperial Court Grandee.

A native of Nanyang Juyang, an official of the Western Jin Dynasty. He was a beautiful woman who was a puisne of the Secretary of State to the powerful minister Jia Chong, and had an affair with his daughter Jia Wu, and was recruited as his son-in-law. The allusion to "stealing incense" is derived from Han Shou.

A native of Yuyang, Youzhou, an official of Cao Wei. After Liu Yu was killed by Gongsun Tzann, he and Yan Rou, Qi Zhou and Xian Yu Yin recruited the Hu-Han people who had been favored by Liu Yu and defeated Gongsun Tzann. 
Afterwards, he was persuaded by Tian Yu to surrender to Cao Cao at the Battle of Guandu.
Lu Bu's general, when Yuan Shao was fighting with Gongsun Tzann, Gongsun Tzann attracted Zhang Yan to help him, and at that time Lu Bu was attached to Yuan Shao.

He was a native of Chenliu Junyi. He was a talented man, but he was killed by Cao Cao because he repeatedly attacked Cao Cao, causing fear among the scholars of Yanzhou. The first time I saw him, I was able to get him to come to my house.

From Xie County, Hedong, Guan Yi was an official of Shu Han, Guan Yu's grandson, and the son of Guan Xing and his concubine. 
The son of Guan Xing and his wife died young so Guan Yi succeeded the title of Marquis of Hanshou Village. In historical records, Pang Hui, the son of Pang De, attacked Shu with Deng Ai and Zhong Hui. When Chengdu fell, Guan Yu and his family were all killed. It seemed to be hinting that Pang Hui did this out of revenge from Guan Yu for killing Pang De.

From Huandao, Nanan, Pang Hui was a general of Cao Wei and the son of Pang De. He was loyal and brave like his father. When Zhuge Dan rebelled in Shouchun, unwilling to rebel with Zhuge Dan, Pang Hui fought his way out of Shouchun with Lu Fan. 
He later attacked Shu with Deng Ai and Zhong Hui. When Chengdu fell, it was hinted that Guan Yu and his family were all killed and Pang Hui did this out of revenge from Guan Yu for killing Pang De.

Native in Qufu, Yanzhou, an alchemist of Wei and Jin Dynasties. Legend has it that Shen Mu was the disciple of Lan Gong and Xu Xun was one of her students. Xu Xun was regarded as the founder of Jingming Taosim and Lushan Sect.

In the history records, he was the subordinate of Liu Zhang and crossed over to Wu after the Battle of Red Cliff. Zhou Yu advised Sun Quan that Lu Meng should be in charge of Xi Su's army, but Lu Meng refused, claiming such would hurt his feelings.

Subordinate of Wutugu, king of the Wuge. At Wutugu's direction, marched with a force 30, 000 men strong with Xi Ni to face off against the Shu army. Falling for Zhuge Liang's feints, he perished in an enemy fire attack.
A fictional character, daughter of Dailai Dongzhu.

A fictional character in the Romance of Three Kingdoms, King Mulu was Meng Huo's subordinate and the lord of Bana Cave of Nanman. He possessed magical powers to command rain and storm as well as controlling wild beasts. He was always seen riding an elephant. He repelled Zhao Yun and Wei Yan with the weather magic and wild beasts. 
However, Zhuge Liang was an expert on commanding rain and storm himself and also learned the art of repelling fierce beasts. Originally thinking he was invincible, King Mulu didn't expect his magic to be countered. In a panic, he fell off his elephant and was killed in the stampede.

A fictional character in the Romance of Three Kingdoms, Mangya Chang was Meng Huo's subordinate who excelled at wielding grand blades. When Meng Huo battled the Shu army for the second time, Mangya Chang was killed when he fought with Ma Dai.

The earliest records about Meng Huo's son is in Anthology of Marquis Zhongwu by Zhang Shu in Qing Dynasty, but it's most likely fictional. 
According to the book, Liu Xun, unwilling to move to Luoyang, fled south with Guan Suo and others. Later Zhuge Zhi, the son of Zhuge Zhan, went to Nanzhong and contacted Meng Qiu. So Meng Qiu accepted Liu Xun and let him take shelter in Yongchang.
A fictional character, daughter of Meng Huo

In the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, this fictional character is the elder brother of Meng Huo. Living a reclusive life near Wan'an River, he called himself Wan'an Hermit. With his help, the Shu army managed to breach Tulong Cave and captured Meng Huo again.
A fictional character, daughter of Shamoke.

Subordinate of Wutugu, king of the Wuge. At Wutugu's direction, marched with a force 30, 000 men strong with Tu An to face off against the Shu army. Falling for Zhuge Liang's feints, he perished in an enemy fire attack.

A fictional character in the Romance of Three Kingdoms, Dailai Dongzhu was the younger brother of Lady Zhurong, Meng Huo's wife. 
After Zhuge Liang released Meng Huo for the 5th time, Dailai Dongzhu suggested him to seek help from King Mulu, an expert on magic and commanding elephants. Though they successfully repelled Zhao Yun and Wei Yan, they still lost to Zhuge Liang. Dailai Dongzhu presented a scheme of trickery but it was disclosed by Zhuge Liang. 
He was captured along with Meng Huo in the end and submitted to Zhuge Liang genuinely.

A fictional character in the Romance of Three Kingdoms, Yang Feng was the lord of the 21 Yinye Caves of Nanman. Enraged that Meng Huo waged a war against Shu, he pretended to lead his troop to aid Meng Huo but set up a banquet to capture the latter and delivered him to the Shu army.
A fictional character, wife of Yang Feng.

The chieftain in Suqi Yi, his wife was the daughter of chieftain of Maoniu Tribe. Dong Feng and his brother Wei Qu surrendered to Shu and then betrayed. Later Dong Feng was killed by Zhang Ni in the expedition.
King of Linyi and son of Fan Xiong. Linyi was a Cham kingdom located in central Vietnam and once rendered tribute to Western Jin dynasty.

The founder of Linyi Qu Lian deceased without an heir, so his grandson Fan Xiong ascended the throne. 
He allied with Funan to invade Wu and managed to occupy Xijuan. When the Rebellion of Jiaozhi broke out, Xue Xu, Chief Governor of Wu, and Tao Huang led an army of hundred thousand men. With Jiaozhi being captureed and Linyi being attacked, Fan Xiong surrendered.
Chieftain in Dingzuo area. Dissatisfied with the appointment of Zhang Ni, he refused to show his presence before Zhang Ni. So Zhang Ni arrested him and he was lashed to death.

The chieftain's daughter of Maoniu Tribe and the wife of Dong Feng, the chieftain in Suqi Yi. 
Dong Feng betrayed Shu and was killed by Zhang Ni. But Zhang Ni never hurt Langgu and sent her back to the tribe safe and sound. In gratitude for Zhang Ni's kindness, the Maoniu Tribe paid allegiance to Shu.

The chieftain of Maoniu Tribe in Hanjia Commandery. He held grudge against Zhang Ni for Dong Feng's death and wanted to revenge for him. But the safe return of his aunt and Zhang Ni's sincerity changed his mind. Finally, the tribes and Han buried the hatchet and united as one.

The chieftain's son of Maoniu Tribe in Hanjia Commandery, uncle of Langli. Under Langlu's order, he would decide whether to attack Zhang Ni or not. Zhang Ni treated him and other tribesmen with feast, as well as returned his sister. This earned Langli's trust.

Wei Qu, younger brother of chieftain Dong Feng. After Dong Feng died, he fled west and ordered two of his subordinates to feign surrender in hope of getting information from inside. But Zhang Ni saw it through and promised them with a heavy bounty on the head of Wei Qu. So they conspired to kill him.
Born in Jiuzhen, the elder brother of Zhao Yu. They rebelled against Wu and triumphed in many battles. The Inspector of Jiaozhou also died on their hands, which has rattled Jiaozhi and Jiuzhen.

Born in Jiuzhen, also known as Lady Trieu. 
Many shcolars claims she is a fictional character, because many accounts about her are local chronicles and the earliest one is one thousand year away from it. 
She and her brother ebelled against Wu and triumphed in many battles. The Inspector of Jiaozhou also died on their hands, which has rattled Jiaozhi and Jiuzhen. 
Later Lu Yin was appointed as the Inspector of Jiaozhou and he led an army of eight thousand to suppress the rebellion. Eventually, driven to despair, she committed suicide. 
Nowadays, she is the national heroine of Vietnam.
The chieftain of Zhuoma Tribe in Nanzhong. He was captured alive by Zhang Ni. Instead of killing him, Zhang Ni released him and let him recruit other tribes for him.
Born in Jianning, Tongle. The leader of local family of Cuan. During the Rebellion of Jiaozhi, he was appointed as the Governor to help Lu Xing oppose Wu.

Native in Jianning, Yizhou, uncle of Li Hui. He was the magistrate of Jianning and was dismissed from office due to commit a crime. During Zhuge Liang's Southern Campaign, he paid allegiance to Shu, being appointed Assistant General and Commander.

The leader of Xianbei and the husband of Kebineng's daughter. Tian Yu sent a translator named Xia She to meet Yuzhujian, but Yuzhujian executed the translator instead. So Tian Yu led an army to attack Yuzhujian and eventually won.

Member of Xiongnu Tuge Tribe. Formally Emperor Guangwen of Han, the founding emperor of Han Zhao dynasty. 
He was the descendant of Modu Chanyu. But because of the marriages with Han royal family, he had the Han surname of Liu. 
Liu Yuan was smart since childhood. He not only read classics extensively, also excelled at equestrian skills and archery. 
Sima Zhao and Sima Yan highly appreciated talents, but they never put him in an important posistion because he was not Han people. 
During the War of Eight Princes, he chose to take side with Sima Ying, the Price of Chengdu. But after Sima Ying failed, Liu Yuan became the warlor with heavy troops. In the same year, he succeeded to throne and claimed himself the King of Han.

The 11th monarch of Goguryeo, also known as King Dongcheon or King Dongyang. 
During the early years of his reign, he allied with Wei and attacked Gongsun Du. And when he also helped Wei suppress the rebellion of Gongsun Yuan. 
After Gongsun Yuan died, Wei established counties in Liaodong, which made Goguryeo fear for itself. So Goguryeo betrayed the alliance and attacked Liaodong. 
Wei sent Guanqiu Jian to lead a punitive expedition to Goguryeo. King Dongcheon was defeated in many battles and escaped to Okjeo.

The legendary queen of Yamatai-koku, she once sent an envoy to the court of Wei. 
She is said to be both priestess and queen. The Japanese historians have disagreements about her true identity that still remains unresolved. 
In Records of the Three Kingdoms, she sent Nashime and Tsushi Gori as envoys to Wei, and Emperor Ming of Wei officially called the Queen of Wa a friend of Wei and awarded the envoys. Five years later, Isegi, Yasuku and others came to Wei again.

In Shiji by Sima Qian, Yu is Xiang Yu's wife that accompanied him on all battles. However, her true name is still unknown. 
In the Battle of Gaixia, the desperate situation and Chu folk songs in the night had crushed the morale of Chu army. 
In despair, Xiang Yu indulged in alcohol and sang the Song of Gaixia. And Yu Ji performed a sword dance and sang a verse in return. 
Later Xiang Yu broke through the enemy line with around 800 men on horses, but when he reached the bank of Wu River, he was ashamed to go back to hometown and committed suicide. 
After Xiang Yu died, Yu Ji also disappeared and no one knew ever since. 
In polular culture, it's said Yu Ji also committed suicide for her beloved Xiang Yu. And her story is regarded as one of the four great romance stories in history.

Since Sui and Tang Dynasties, there existed a tradition to build Martial Temple to worship Jiang Ziya. 
During Song Dynasty, the new upsurge of Huaben and the wars made the loyal and valiant Guan Yu deeply rooted in people's hearts. And it is said that Guan Yu's temple can be seen in very county. 
Nearly all monarchs in history granted Guan Yu new titles, now he is regarded as the Sait of War. In some Taoism, people say Guan Yu is the current Jade Emperor. 
Other than Taoism, Master Zhiyi of Tiantan also worshipped Guan Yu as the Samgharama Bodhisattva. 
With Chinese culture spreading afar, Japan, Korea and even Tibetan Buddhism also worshipped Guan Yu. Nowadays, Guan Yu is obviously the most popular deity in the East Asian cultural sphere.

The daughter of Himiko's Clan, Queen of the State of Yamatai in ancient Japanese legends. 
After Himiko died, a male was enthroned the king, but the country refused to accept it, which led to a civil war before Toyo being enthroned. At that time, Toyo was only thirteen. 
After having succeeded to the throne, Toyo sent a Japanese grandee to take twenty persons including Yasuku, the General of the Palace Gentlemen, to serve as envoys. 
In addition, although her name was recorded as Yiyu in "The History of the Three Kingdoms", according to research, it might be that Chen Shou had changed the characters to avoid the offence of Emperor Jin. Toyo was more likely to be the real name.

According to "The History of the Three Kingdoms-Records of Wei-Biography of the Japanese", Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai, once sent the Grandee Nashime, and Vice Convoy Tsushi Gori to visit Cao Wei. 
Nashime arrived at Daifang County. Then Liu Xia, the Governor of Daifang County, sent officials to the capital to pay homage to Cao Rui, the Emperor Ming of Wei. 
Later, Emperor Ming issued an imperial edict, and conferred Himiko as "The King of Japan". 
In addition, Nashime was promoted to the rank of Shuaishan General of the Palace Gentlemen, and Tsushi Gori was the Commandant, both of whom were awarded the Blue Ribbon Silver Seal. 
After that until Young Emperor Cao Fang succeeded to the throne, as long as the two countries contacted with each other, Nashime played a key role in it.

According to "The History of the Three Kingdoms-Records of Wei-Biography of the Japanese", Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai, once sent him and the Grandee Nashime to visit Cao Wei. 
He was awarded a Blue Ribbon Silver Seal by Emperor Ming of Wei, and was appointed as the Shuaishan Commandant.

According to "The History of the Three Kingdoms - Records of Wei - Biography of the Japanese", Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai, once sent Saishi and Uwo to Daifang County which belonged to Wei, to tell the local Governor Wang Qi that she had conflicts with Himikuko, the Male King of State of Kuna. 
Afterwards, Wang Qi sent Zhang Zheng to mediate between the two countries with imperial edicts and the Flag of Honor.

According to "The History of the Three Kingdoms - Records of Wei - Biography of the Japanese", Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai, once sent Saishi and Uwo to Daifang County which belonged to Wei, to tell the local Governor Wang Qi that she had conflicts with Himikuko, the Male King of State of Kuna. 
Afterwards, Wang Qi sent Zhang Zheng to mediate between the two countries with imperial edicts and the Flag of Honor.

According to"The History of the Three Kingdoms - Records of Wei - Biography of the Japanese", Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai, sent eight envoys including Grandee Isegi and Yasuku to State of Wei in the 4th year of Cao Fang's reign after the diplomatic relations between Yamatai and Wei having been established. 
After Himiko passed away and the Clan Daughter Toyo succeeded to the throne, Toyo ordered Zhang Zheng, who escorted the envoys to Yamatai, to return to Cao Wei.

According to "The History of the Three Kingdoms - Records of Wei - Biography of the Japanese", Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai, sent eight envoys including Grandee Isegi and Yasuku to State of Wei in the 4th year of Cao Fang's reign after the diplomatic relations between Yamatai and Wei having been established.

She is described as a witch in "The Story of Chikugo Country Folklore". 
A supporter and researcher of the Kyushu Dynasty Theory, believes that it actually referred to the Queen of Yamatai in "The History of the Three Kingdoms - Records of Wei - Biography of the Japanese".

Due to the lack of reliable historical books in early Japan, the year of her life and death recorded in the two books of "Japan Antiquities" and "Chronicles of Japan" was quite different. 
Her life and deeds were mostly legends, which were difficult to verify. She was the common ancestors of the Ji Clan, the Koseno Clan, the Heguri Clan, the Katsuragi Clan, and the Sogano Clan, being worshipped as a God, also known as "Takenouchi no Sukune". 
Legend has it that she assisted the Queen of Jingu Kogo in rebellion. The "Chronicles of Japan" mentioned that the Queen of Jingu Kogo had sent envoys to China, and believed that the Queen of Jingu Kogo was actually Himiko, the Queen of Yamatai.

"Japan Antiquities" and "Chronicles of Japan" recorded that he was the younger brother of Takenouchi no Sukune and the great-grandson of Emperor Kogen Tenno. 
Umashiuchi no Sukune once slandered Takenouti no tsukune to the emperor, with the intention of making Takenouchi no Sukune fall. 
Takenouchi no Sukune tried to defend himself to the emperor, who ordered the two to perform the ritual of Boiling Pot Trial. 
Umashiuchi no Sukune did not pass the trial, but were remitted the punishment in the end. 
The so-called ritual of Boiling Pot Trial is to put your hands in a pot of boiling water or poisonous snakes. 
If the hand is not injured, it proves that the person has been judged by God to be upright and innocent.

The son of Takenouchi no Sukune and the ancestor of the Katsuragi Clan. 
Legend has it that he was active in the diplomacy of Japan, Baekje, Silla and other ancient countries on the Korean Peninsula.

In the "Chronicles of Japan", it is said that he crusaded the Ryomen Sukuna. 
In addition, it is said that he once served as an official in the same court as Takenouchi no Sukune, and assisted the Queen of Jingu Kogo to put down the rebellion.

The younger sister of the Queen of Jingu Kogo. 
If the Queen of Jingu Kogo is actually Himiko, then Toyohime is likely to be Toyo.

Only recorded in the "Chronicles of Japan", not included in the "Japan Antiquities". The ancestor of the Nakatomi Clan, and in the same period of the Queen of Jingu Kogo. 
Some Japanese scholars believe that the Nakatomi Clan originated from the official post of "Priest" in ancient Japan, who was mainly responsible for the sacrificial matters of the imperial court to convey the will of deity.

The king of the State of Kuna according to "The History of the Three Kingdoms-Records of Wei-Biography of the Japanese", but the actual power is seized by Kukochihiko. 
There was a clash between the State of Kuna and the Yamatai ruled by Himiko. The two states fought several times, and thousands of people died. 
Wang Qi, the Governor of Daifang County of Wei, sent Zhang Zheng to mediate between the two countries with imperial edict and the Flag of Honor.

A powerful courtier and actual power holder of the State of Kuna according to "The History of the Three Kingdoms - Records of Wei-Biography of the Japanese". 
There was a saying that it was Hiko Kikuchi.
Being in the same era as the Queen of Queen of Jingu Kogo, one of the tyrannical leaders of Kumaso, and was conquered by the Queen of Jingu Kogo, according to the "Chronicles of Japan".

In "Chronicles of Japan", she was mentioned to be the witch queen of Earth Spider in Yamato County area, whose elder brother was Kabane. 
Was suppressed and killed by the Queen of Jingu Kogo. 
Some people believed that she was a descendant of Himiko. 
In addition, the so-called Earth Spider originally referred to the local tycoons and indigenous peoples who were unwilling to submit to the Yamato regime.

In "Chronicles of Japan", she was mentioned to be the elder brother of Tabura-tsu-hime, the witch queen of Earth Spider in Yamato County area. 
When the Queen of Jingu Kogo attacked Tabura-tsu-hime, Kabane went to rescue with troops. 
But before the army arrived, Tabura-tsu-hime was already annihilated. Then Kabane fled, whose whereabouts had been unknown ever since.

At the beginning, he was conferred a posthumous title as Marquis Shunping due to the Emperor Liu Shan was grateful for his kindness and righteousness, to be worshipped together with Liu Bei. 
A general temple dedicated to worship Zhao Yun was also built in front of Zhao Yun's tomb at the foot of Yinping Mountain in Dayi County of Chengdu. 
Due to his bravery and loyalty, and the great merit of rescuing the young emperor, some people gradually regarded him as a god. 
Zhao Yun was painted as the Gate-God in New Year pictures in Shandong, Shanxi and parts of Shaanxi. 
In China Taiwan, there are also temples dedicated to worship Zhao Yun, among which the origin of Yongchang Temple in south Taiwan is the most mysterious.

I am Lu Bu, who dares to fight with me!
(Devil Lu Bu appears in the north of Chang'an)
After Devil Lu Bu died, he dissipated into a burst of magic energy, leaving only a stone on site.
Yellow Turban staged an armed insurrection. Governor posted announcement to recruit volunteers, one person looking at it and sighing.
"A true man doesn't contribute to the state but only making sigh here, how come?"

"What you said is quite true. May I know your name?"
(He has a ferocious look with big eyes and beards, as if he were a hero...)
"My name is Zhang Fei. You can call me Zhang Yide as well. I just saw you watching at the announcement and sighing, so I came for a talk."
"My name is Liu Bei. My ancestor is the Han clan. The Yellow Turban staged its rebellion, but I hate myself for lack of strength."
"Well, I happen to have some wealth. I want to recruit the volunteers. Why not join us? Let's do something big together."

The two shared the same interests and headed to the winery to have a drink. At that moment, they saw a majestic-looking man
over there.
"Bring me the liquor! I'm waiting to enlist myself after drinking!"
Seeing this man bearing out of the ordinary, Liu Bei and Zhang Fei invited him to a seat.
He is Guan Yu (also named Guan Yunchang), who fled because of killing a local bully. He came for joining the volunteers.

The three of them are like-minded and cherish each other. They headed to Zhang Fei's Manor together and discussed
their future ambitions.
The three people worship the heaven and earth and become sworn brothers. Hence the story of "Peach Garden Oath."

No one knows that would become the prologue of the 
Rivalry of Warlords and the troubled times of the Three Kingdoms in the future.

Young emperor Liu Bian ascended throne. With Queen Mother He's assistance, Grand General
He Jin's influence in court gradually increased.
He Jin planned with Yuan Shao and others to eradicate the eunuch and the Queen Mother Dong who are opposed to him…
"General Sir, is there any conclusion after discussing with the Queen Mother?"
"Her Majesty rejected it, what should I do?"
"We should call on heroes of the world, ask them to bring troops into the capital and kill all eunuchs. We can't wait any longer."

"No! This can't be done! All the heroes does not have one mind. It is like taking the sword upside down, 
and let the enemy hold the hilt."
"I have decided. Stop speaking those cowardly words."
"This plan of intending to eliminate all the eunuchs will definitely be revealed. I am sure it will be a failure."
Dong Zhuo has not yet entered the capital, and He Jin's plan has been leaked, just as Cao Cao expected.
After eunuch killed He Jin, Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu led army into court and killed eunuchs on sight. Queen Mother fled with young emperor.
When young emperor and Lord of Chenliu was wandering in wilderness, they met Dong Zhuo and were greeted and escorted back to Luoyang city.
Dong Zhuo was rewarded the governor of Luoyang, but he intended to abolish the Emperor and let Lord Chengliu ascend the throne.
But, Ding Yuan disagreed. So Dong Zhuo presents Lu Bu Red Hare steed and other treasure to instigate him, then Lu Bu beheaded Ding Yuan.
After that, Young Emperor was abolished and Liu Xie ascended the throne as the emperor. Hence the Dong Zhuo's reign of terror was unveiled.
Dong Zhuo wanted to abolish Liu Bian and support Liu Xie, taking this plan to strengthen his own power to eradicate opponents.
He first lured Lu Bu to kill Ding Yuan and seized his troops, and repelled his opponent Yuan Shao.
Dong Zhuo pushed Liu Xie to the throne. He also killed Queen Mother He, and finally made Dong Zhuo the real power holder of Han Dynasty.
Dong Zhuo practiced the reign of terror, indulging soldiers to commit adultery and looting, which aroused the anger of the heroes.
At this time, Cao Cao issued an announcement to the feudal princes in the name of the emperor, to declare a war against Dong Zhuo…
"Dong Zhuo destroyed country and kills emperor, disturbing court injunction and slaughtering. He is a violent criminal full of guilt!"
"I received a secret order from the emperor, asking me to call on volunteers from all over the world. I will wipe out all the crime."
"I hope to call together a righteous army to fight against the common enemy. Please get back to me as soon as you see this announcement!"
After the announcement was released, many princes responded. Yuan Shao was promoted to the leader of the Anti-Dong Zhuo Alliance.
Dong Zhuo dispatched Hua Xiong to Sishui Pass. Yuan Shao assigned Sun Jian as vanguard and Yuan Shu as officer responsible for grain supply.
Hua Xiong was invincible. Yuan Shu was jealous of Sun Jian, so he did not send grain to him to prevent him from making exploits.
Sun Jian defeated Dong Zhuo's army. But Hua Xiong performed a night attack, which made Sun Jian loose the battlefield advantage.
Sun Jian was defeated at Sishui Pass, and his officers was beheaded by Hua Xiong. Yuan Shao had to find someone else to slay Hua Xiong.
"It's a pity that my officers Yan Liang and Wen Chou have not arrived yet! If one of them is there, why bother being afraid of Hua Xiong!"
"I volunteer to challenge Hua Xiong, behead him and bring you his head!"
"Who are you? What position do you hold now?"
"I am following Liu Xuande as a cavalry archer."
"Are you mocking us for not having officers? Nothing more than a cavalry archer. How dare you! Get this shit out of my sight!"
"Don't be mad. This man looks good, how could Hua Xiong know that he is an archer?"
"General, take this glass of liquor and be bold!"
"Set aside the liquor. I'll be back in a minute."
Only after a short of time, Guan Yu brought Hua Xiong's head back to the camp, but the liquor was still warm, making everyone shocked!
Dong Zhuo learned that Hua Xiong died and assigned Lu Bu to fight. He killed 2 officers soon, and making 2 officers suffered heavy damage.
Zhang Fei drove forward to help. After fighting for more than 50 consecutive rounds, it was still hard to tell who would be the winner.

Guan Yu then grabbed his Moonfall Blade and stepped forward to help and attacked Lu Bu, extending the fight for
another 30 rounds.
Liu Bei took his twin swords and rode forward, making Lu Bu besieged by the three of them. Lu Bu then retreated with his Red Hare steed.
The Allied Forces of eight feudal princes declared their victory of this battle and carried out a celebration.
Dong Zhuo indulges his soldiers to loot and slaughter willfully, so princes gathered their forces to declare a war against Dong Zhuo.

Yuan Shao, Sun Jian and Cao Cao made
Guandong Allied Forces. Sun Jian was vanguard, Dong Zhuo asked Li Ru if he had any countermeasures.

"Lu Bu has just been defeated. It's better to bring troops to Luoyang and move capital
to Chang'an, so that it would be safe."
"Great solution! If it weren't for your reminder, I really didn't realize it!"
Then Dong Zhuo summoned a group of ministers immediately and informed them the plan of relocating the capital.
I want to go to Chang'an in the name of the emperor. All of you prepare your luggage and come with me!"
Some ministers disagreed with relocating the capital. But, Dong Zhuo beheaded wealthy households and taking away all their family property.
He also instructed his subordinates to steal funerary objects from the tombs of the royal family, nobles, and wealthy people.
Dong Zhuo led his infantry and cavalry to compulsorily move people from Luoyang to Chang'an, making the roads full of corpses everywhere.
Dong Zhuo also set fire to Luoyang city, burning all the palaces and residences, ruining everything in the capital.
Then Dong Zhuo moved west and Cao Cao wanted to kill him. Neglecting Yuan Shao's dissuasion, he chased Dong Zhuo's army as fast as he can.
But, he fell into Li Ru's trap and was intercepted by Lu Bu, Cao Cao was almost killed. Fortunately, several officers rescued him in time.
Sun Jian entered Luoyang palace and saw the big fire. Someone reported that a treasure was salvaged from a well in the imperial seraglio…
Eight large characters were engraved on it: "Rule by the Grace of God and Long Live the Country."
"This is the Royal Seal! Rumor has it that the Retinue Eunuchs staged their rebellion, and it was lost after they returning to the palace."
"It is an opportunity to ascend the throne. We should go back to Jiangdong as fast as we can and plan for the future."
"This is just what I want. Tomorrow, I will be dismissed under the guise of a serious illness and return to Jiangdong."
"There was no hatred between Dong Zhuo and me. But today, I'll fight to the death, not only for eliminating traitor, but also for you..."
"However, you believed the slander and didn't deliver me the grain, which resulted in a defeat for me. Why were you doing this to me?"
Yuan Shu was frightened and speechless. He had no choice but ordered to kill the slanderer and apologize to Sun Jian.
Suddenly someone reported to Sun Jian that Li Jue came here to visit him. Sun Jian took leave to Yuan Shu and returned to his own camp.

"I, Li Jue, am here to bring up proposal of marriage. The prime minister has a
girl, and he is willing to let her marry your son."

"Dong Zhuo is brutal and he persecutes royal family. 
How could I propose a marriage with a traitor? I don't want to kill you. Leave now!"

Li Jue left in disgrace. Sun Jian refused Dong Zhuo's proposal of marriage and marched into Luoyang, repelling the remaining 
enemy.
But, Sun Jian could not get the support of other princes. After repairing the Han Dynasty imperial tombs, he led his army back to Luyang.
Although Sun Jian was able to attack Luoyang, each of the princes and warlords in the coalition had their own axe to grind.
"Who would be my comrades in arms to fight the evil and save the people?" (He shed tears after he finished speaking.)
Sun Jian had never received the support of the other forces in the coalition. The campaign against Dong Zhuo ended without much success.
Sun Jian was ordered by Yuan Shu to attack Jingzhou. Then he engaged a surprise night attack, making the enemy troops fled to Xianshan.

Sun Jian pursued them with victory. When they chased into the canyon, the enemy ambushed at the mountain gorge threw
logs and rocks at them.
Sun Jian failed to notice and was hit by a falling rock. He was killed with his brain burst out.

Yuan Shu was not willing to
fame Sun Ce with accomplishments, so Sun Ce grew distrustful of Yuan Shu.
After Sun Ce returned from attacking Lujiang victoriously, Yuan Shu appointed Liu Xun as Lujiang Governor, breaking his promise to Sun Ce.
Feeling depressed for being treated like this by Yuan Shu, Sun Ce was pacing till he reached the middle of the courtyard and sighing…
"My father was such a hero, but why I am treated like this!"
"Why are you crying alone here? Your father used to put me in an important position. Why don't you ask me for help?"
It turned out that he was the old minister Zhu Zhi, so he told him that he failed to inherit his father's will.

"You can borrow troops from Yuan Shu to Jiangdong, under the guise of saving Wu Jing, 
with real purpose for building up your strength?"
Sun Ce was overjoyed with this plan, the next day he discussed with Yuan Shu about borrowing troops.

"Since I still haven't avenged my father yet, and my uncle Wu Jing is forced by Yangzhou governor. My family

"I wish to borrow soldiers from you. If you can't trust me, I can leave the Jade Seal, the relic from my father, to you as a guarantee."
Yuan Shu was overjoyed when he saw Jade Seal. Sun Ce could already see that he was already vacillating in his mind.

"It's okay to give me this guarantee. I can lend soldiers 
to you. You shall return soon when you finished the rescue action."
Yuan Shu proclaimed himself the emperor after he got Jade Seal. While Sun Ce summoned his father's old subordinate and pacified Jiangdong.
After Lu Bu turned to Liu Bei, Cao Cao ordered Liu Bei to attack Yuan Shu in name of emperor. Lu Bu then took the chance to captured Xuzhou.
After Lu Bu won Xuzhou and making the expedition against Yuan Shu failed, Liu Bei had nowhere to go and garrisoned in Pei County.
At the moment, Yuan Shu appointed Ji Ling to lead an army to attack Liu Bei, and Lu Bu acted as a big brother to mediate.
"I want to persuade you not to fight. Bring my halberd! Whether you fight today or not, let the destiny decide."

"If I hit the halberd with a single shot, your two stop the fight; 
if I failed, I will leave you two going back to prepare the battle."
Ji Ling agreed. Liu Bei had no choice but only praying that Lu Bu could hit it.
Lu Bu did it. Ji Ling and Liu Bei were amazed. Since Ji Ling had just made the promise, he definitely wouldn't break it.
"Hahaha, this is God's will that you should suspend combat here!"
"Since you put it that way, I won't refuse."
"Liu Bei, today I kept you out of the distress. If you succeed in the future, don't forget it!"

Cao Cao led his army to conquer Xuzhou and defeated Lu Bu, making him retreat to Xiapi City.
2 months later, Lu Bu's subordinate tied him up in his sleep and opened city gate to surrender. Cao Cao interrogated Lu Bu and his officers.
Cao Cao asked Gao Shun first, but he didn't answer. Cao Cao became angry and ordered to behead Gao Shun. Then he interrogated Chen Gong,
"You claim to be resourceful, so what are you going to say at the moment?"
"I hate Lu Bu for not taking my advice! If he listened to me, I may not be captured."
Although Cao Cao wanted to accept Chen Gong as a subordinate, he refused, so he had to behead Chen Gong.
In the end it was Lu Bu's turn to be interrogated. Lu Bu immediately begged Cao Cao for mercy…
"I have already surrendered. I would like to be your Lieut. General. Then it would not be hard to conquer the world for us."
Cao Cao was fascinated by Lu Bu's bravery and talents, so he asked Liu Bei for opinion, but the answer aroused Lu Bu's hatred and anger.
"My lord, have you forgotten about Ding Yuan and Dong Zhuo?"
"You are not keeping promises! You piece of shit! Have you forgotten what happened during the time of Shooting Halberd?"
Liu Bei still did not say anything to save him, but Cao Cao finally ordered Lu Bu to be hanged. A famous officer has bought the farm.
Emperor Xian of Han Dynasty did not want to be controlled by Cao Cao anymore. He ordered his uncle to gather forces to slay Cao Cao.
But the information were leaked out. Liu Bei who is supporting from outside is fiercely attacked by Cao Cao.
Liu Bei fled, Zhang Fei disappeared, and only Guan Yu was guarding Xiapi...

Cao Cao sent Zhang Liao, Guan Yu's old friend, to persuade him to surrender.
"Why don't you surrender Cao Cao, and wait for the moment of hearing from Liu Bei again before your departure?"

"Here are 3 requests that I want to make an agreement with the prime minister. Once he agreed, I would surrender immediately."
"The prime minister is magnanimous, what he won't agree to? I'm listening."
"First, I only surrender myself to the Emperor of Han Dynasty, not Cao Cao."
"Second, please provide salary to my two sisters-in-law as the same standard as Liu Bei, and all of you should not visit them."
"Third, as long as I hear from Liu Bei, I will leave here. All the 3 things are indispensable. I hope you will get back to me ASAP."
Zhang Liao reported to Cao Cao, mentioned about that Guan Yu was surrendering himself to the Han Dynasty, not Cao Cao.
"I am the prime minister of the Han Dynasty, so I represent the Han. This can be promised."
"Providing salary to the two sisters-in-law as the same standard as Liu Bei, and no one was allowed to visit."
"I can provide even more. As for the prohibition of visiting them. It's family law, so definitely there is no problem."
"Finally, as long as he hears from Liu Bei, he will leave even if it is far away."
"In this case, what is the point for me to recruit Guan Yu? It's hard to promise."

"If you can provide more favors than Liu Bei, and lure him with what he wants, why bother
worrying about Guan Yu's sincerity of surrender?"
"Your words are quite reasonable, then I will agree to these three requests."

Knowing that Cao Cao agreed, Guan Yu went to ask Liu Bei's wife for advice, then headed
to visit Cao Cao. Cao Cao was very courteous to him.
Cao Cao sent troops to invade. Xu Shu showed his talents, he saw through the "Eight-gate Golden-lock Circle" and defeated Cao's army.
Cao Cao went to Jingzhou to pursue Liu Bei. Not only did Liu Bei lose a lot of resources, Xu Shu's mother was also captured by Cao Cao.
Cao Cao imitated hand-writing of Xu's mother, and forged the message that she would be killed, in order to lure Xu Shu to Cao Cao's camp.
"Please stay. We shall say goodbye here."
"Once you leave at the moment, I don't know when we will meet again."
Liu Bei feel sad, tears raining down. At the moment, he saw Xu Shu riding his horse and headed back. Liu Bei was happy and hurriedly asked.
"Sir, don't you plan to go to Cao's Camp?"
"There is a miraculous person who lives in Longzhong, which is 20 miles away from the Xiangyang City. Why don't you go for a visit?"
"Could you please invite him for me?"
"This person won't have himself at other's beck and call, you'd better visit him by yourself. This person is Zhuge Liang (Kongming)."
"His residence is in a valley called Wolonggang, and he calls himself Mr. Wolong."

"Mr. Water Mirror said: "Wolong and Fengchu, if you get one, you could conquer
the world." Is the person Wolong or Fengchu?"
"Fengchu is Pang Tong in Xiangyang City. Wolong is Zhuge Kongming."

"The sage is just so close to me. If it is not for
the words from you, I am just as same as a blind man!"
After bidding farewell to Liu Bei, Xu Shu came to Xudu. Xu's mother was furious after seeing him.

Blaming it for not being able to discern fake hand-writings. 
Xu Shu then saddened because Xu's mother hanged herself in the room and died.
Liu Bei brought Guan Yu and Zhang Fei to Zhuge Liang's thatched cottage. A boy said that Zhuge Liang was not in and said farewell to them.
The 2nd time, Liu Bei brought Guan Yu and Zhang Fei to Wolonggang. This time Zhuge Liang was out for a leisure trip with his friends.
"Since we can't meet him, let's go back, shall we?"
"It's better we go back first, and then ask someone else to come and leave a message."
"He is just a villager, why should you come to visit by yourself? Just send a messenger to call him over."
"My bro, Zhuge Kongming is a great sage in the world. How can he be simply called over!"
For the third time, Liu Bei came to Zhuge Liang's thatched cottage. This time, Zhuge Liang was at home, but he was asleep in the cottage.
They waited outside for several hours until Zhuge Liang woke up. Liu Bei recounted the history and reasons of the previous 2 visits to him.
Zhuge Liang talked about the general trend of the world, and analyzed the pros and cons for Liu Bei. Liu Bei was surprised and admired.
Zhuge Liang also proposed statement of "Longzhong Conversation" here, providing a plan for dividing the world into 3 kingdoms.
Liu Bei kept asking Zhuge Liang to come out to assist him, but Zhuge Liang repeatedly declined. Liu Bei asked again tearfully…
Seeing that Liu Bei was so sincere, Zhuge Liang finally agreed. Since then, he had made countless achievements for Shu Kingdom afterward.
After Cao Cao defeated Liu Bei in Battle of Changban. Besides Sun Quan, the veteran officials headed by Zhang Zhao proposed to surrender.
Zhuge Liang tried to persuade Sun Quan to ally with Liu Bei. But in the conference, Zhang Zhao started to interrogate Zhuge Liang.
"I heard that with your assistance, Liu Bei might be able to capture Jingzhou. How come all his own territories were given to Cao Cao now?"
"Although it's easy to take the land, His Majesty is considering better strategies that extraordinary people can't understand."
"Then why your soldiers fled when they see Cao's army? It can be seen that it is worse than before for Liu Bei after he recruited you!"
"After the person is getting better from seriously ill, then can take meat and strong medicine to eradicate the disease."
"His Majesty is newly defeated, just like the moment of being seriously ill. What is needed at this time is a good doctor like me."
"The national development and the safety of the whole country require strategic planning."
"Cao Cao is now garrisoned with millions of soldiers and officers, intending to capture Jiangxia. What do you think about it?"
"Cao Cao incorporated crowd of rabble from Yuan Shao into his forces. Although there were many people, there is no need to worry about it."
"Liu Bei's army was defeated in Dangyang, but he still said there was no need to worry. It is really rodomontading!"

"How can His Majesty fight against millions of cruel people? Retreating to
Xiakou was just waiting for the opportunity."
"Jiangdong soldiers are strong enough, but advisers propose their lord to surrender. In this way, my lord is the true hero!"
"Sir, are you going to follow the example of Zhang Yi and Su Qin in lobbying the Kingdom of Wu?"
"Your Excellency, you considered Su Qin and Zhang Yi as debaters, but you didn't know that they were also heroes."
"They are not afraid of blades. All of you are surrendered once hearing Cao Cao's false words. How dare you laugh at them?"
Sun Quan was almost persuaded, but the plan of repelling Cao's army was still not carried out.

"Cao Cao has wiped out almost all his troublesome enemies. So far, those heroes had all disappeared, and only Liu Bei 
and me remained."
"I can't control land of Wu while I'm still controlled by others. But Liu Bei had just lost the battle. Can he survive this catastrophe?"
"Although our army has just been defeated, there are still ten thousand of elite soldiers and a team of brave Jiangxia warriors."
"Cao's army and his Light Cavalry were exhausted. And his soldiers from the north are not good at warfare on the river."

"The people of Jingzhou clinging to Cao Cao were forced by the situation. If you can
ally with our lord, we can defeat Cao Cao."
"After Cao's army is defeated, he will definitely return to the north. I hope you will make the decision ASAP."
"I have already decided. We are going to discuss the strategy of fighting against them and eliminate Cao Cao right today!"
Zhuge Liang successfully promoted the Alliance of Sun and Liu, and preparation for the Battle of Chibi in the future is started from now.
Considering that it was the time, Guan Yu took the expedition against Cao Cao to the north. The first city to be conquered was Fancheng.
Guan Yu led troops to attack Fancheng, while Cao Cao dispatched the Officer Yu Jin to support Xiangfan.
However, the heavy rain in Fancheng made Han River rapidly raised to a height of fifty or sixty feet, making troops of Cao Cao flooded...
Yu Jin and Pang De climbed up to the high to avoid the flood, but Guan Yu took the opportunity to lead the marines to attack Cao's army.

Some officers under Pang De's command were
intended to surrender but executed by Pang De.
Guan Yu's offensive gradually became fierce, and Pang De's arrows were also running out…
Pang De wanted to escape by boat. But the boat sank and he was captured by Guan Yu.
Guan Yu defeated Yu Jin and Pang De's army. All the rioters of the neighborhood also came to seek incorporation under Guan Yu's command.

苟有文義, 目所一見, 必貫于心。
能戰當戰, 不能戰當守, 不能守當走, 餘二事惟有降與死耳。
錦幔揚, 金鈴響, 吾舉長刀, 誰敢渡江？
且卻兵, 但身決勝負！
士別三日, 即更刮目相待。
此國家大事, 吾不可以私憾而忘公義乎！
以德為盾, 刀誅邪逆。
浴血鏖戰, 亦不言退。
奏曲談笑, 強虜灰飛煙滅。
某作一書, 陳說利害。以此成業, 猶反掌也。
勢無優劣, 正欲戰死以彰前志。
父精母血, 不可棄也！
兵情主速, 乘人不及。
將士用命, 隨妾入陣。
同舉義兵, 將救社稷。
虎等群盜, 非有大志, 此成禽耳。
夫存不忘亡, 安必慮危, 古之善教。
今假精兵, 為軍先置, 後截其裏, 賊可擒也。
秉忠貞之志, 守謙退之節。
天下健者, 豈唯誰人？某當取之！
以土承火, 正應其運。代漢者, 吾應其讖。
馬氏五常, 白眉最良。
吾匣中寶劍新磨。汝試言之。
關戎鐵騎, 忠心為漢。
惟天惠民, 惟辟奉天。
待吾屈指一算, 計彼兵糧虛實。
身是張益德也, 可來共決死！
成敗之機, 在此一戰, 諸君何疑？
圍城必示之活門, 所以開其生路也。
文章經國之大業, 不朽之盛事。
對酒當歌, 人生幾何？譬如朝露, 去日苦多。
眾談足矣, 入室何私乎？
以吾觀之, 必死於匹夫之手。
與公瑾交, 若飲醇醪, 不覺自醉。
虛則補之, 實則瀉之, 寒則溫之, 熱則涼之。
大人勿憂, 妾若不報大義, 死於萬刃之下。
軍勢百密, 不免一疏, 勝機在心。
豎子欺吾年老！吾手中寶刀卻不老！
某受厚恩, 故獻此計。吾雖受苦, 亦無所恨。
順我者生, 逆我者死！
但顧萬全, 必決其機, 須臾可定。
念君去我時, 獨愁常苦悲。出亦復苦愁, 入亦復苦愁。
一身是膽, 終不背德。
淡泊以明志, 寧靜以致遠。
事成, 可得天下；富貴同享之。
巧計連環, 下中上策。
我受國恩, 義在效死。我不殺敵, 敵當殺我。
初生之犢 豈敢挑戰 吾父虎威！
溫酒未寒, 將斬敵將。
佳人力拔山, 一怒傾人城。
非汝之能也, 勝之不武, 如何肯服！
承先祖之焰, 懲後人之敵。
取封侯爵賞, 正在今日！
若不早圖, 彼必害我。天下其如我何？
天下不如意, 恒十居七八。
愛兵如子, 恩信御下, 士當盡死力以報。
軍旅之間, 可以濟者, 其惟仁恕乎!
不能清中原而復濟者, 有如大江！
長槍鐵騎敵男兒, 御馬領兵賽父兄。
吾先與操有讎, 安得相容？
欲死不能得, 欲生無一可。彼蒼者何辜, 乃遭此厄禍。
禳星拜斗布奇陣, 騰雲驅霧困千軍。
兵在夜而不驚, 將聞變而不亂。真將才也！
誠如此, 則國家幸甚！
求勝何須千軍出, 河間一將定勝負。
吾每觀書傳, 常鄙隨陸無武, 絳灌無文。
出入弋獵, 建立旌麾, 以鼓節為進退。
東明聖太王 朱蒙 護佑！
八百萬神佑我眾, 驅請鬼道破敵軍。
貞情烈魄揮劍起, 蛾眉思計分王憂。
萬古勳名顯神威, 千秋忠義護萬民。
王意決死戰, 妾亦何聊生?
立身天地, 當盡忠孝節義, 若負吾教, 請試吾刀。
一往無前, 有死無二！此即為陷。陣。營！
奉令討賊, 凡士卒退卻不進者, 殺之！
寡人善將將, 凡當世人傑, 吾能用之取天下也, 何畏！
吾率兵決戰, 所當者破, 所擊者服, 未嘗敗北, 霸有天下！
千軍萬馬, 吾亦不懼！
丹心義膽, 壯士慷慨！粉骨碎身, 不易志節！
持軍嚴整, 令出如山。若有違者, 雖故舊亦不可恕。
大風起兮雲飛揚, 威加海內兮歸故鄉, 安得猛士兮守四方！
彼坐擁天下又如何？吾可取而代也！
君有德被黔黎之志, 將以忠義竭節為報。
天下三分人間亂, 萬古戰魂吞龍氣！
